Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.photoviewer

Class PhotoLibrary

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.photoviewer.PhotoLibrary
public class PhotoLibrary extends Object
The photo viewer's library model: an ordered collection of PhotoItems plus the pure query logic the gallery needs (de-duplicated insertion by path, tag / keyword / rating filtering and the union of all tags). AWT-free, so it is unit-testable headless; the panel simply reflects the returned lists.

    • filter

      public List<PhotoItem> filter(String tag, String keyword, int minRating)
      The photos matching a filter: those carrying tag (when non-blank), whose title contains keyword (case-insensitive, when non-blank), and whose rating is at least minRating. A blank tag / keyword and a minRating of 0 match everything.
      Parameters:
      tag - a required tag, or null/blank for "any"
      keyword - a title substring, or null/blank for "any"
      minRating - the minimum star rating (0..5)
      Returns:
      the matching photos, in insertion order
